options.html: y = f ( x ) + e ^ { - f ( x ) } - c

options.label: B
options.html: y = f ( x ) + c e ^ { - f ( x ) } - 1

options.label: C
options.html: y = cf(x)e^{-f(x)} - 1

options.label: D
options.html: \begin{aligned}y = f(x) + ce^{-f(x)} + 1\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} y = e^{- \int f'(x) dx} [ \int f(x) f'(x) e^{\int f'(x) dx} dx + c ] \\ = e^{-f(x)} [ \int f(x) f'(x) e^{f(x)} dx + c ] \\ = e^{-f(x)} [ \int f(x) e^{f(x)} df(x) + c ] \\ = e^{-f(x)} [ e^{f(x)} (f(x) - 1) + c ] \\ = f(x) + c e^{-f(x)} - 1 \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \text{函数满足}f(x)+f'(x)=e^{x},\text{且}f(0)=0,\text{则}f(x)=()

options.label: A

options.label: B
options.html: \frac{1}{2}(e^{2x}-e^{-x})

options.label: C
options.html: \frac{1}{2}(e^{x}+e^{-x})

options.label: D
options.html: \frac{1}{2}(e^{x}-e^{-x})

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由一阶线性微分方程的求解公式}\\&y=e^{-1\lambda x}[\int e^{x}e^{1\lambda x}\,\mathrm{d}x+c]=\frac{1}{2}e^{x}+ce^{-x},\text{代入初值}f(0)=0,\,\,\text{得}c=-\frac{1}{2},\\&\text{所以}f(x)=\frac{1}{2}(e^{x}-e^{-x})\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} & \text{该方程可化为一阶线性非齐次方程，}\sin y\frac{dy}{dx}-\cos y=x，\text{即}\frac{d\cos y}{dx}+\cos y=-x，\text{令}\\& z=\cos y\ ,\text{则为一阶线性非齐次方程}z'+z=-x\text{其中}\\& P(x)=1,Q(x)=-x\\& \cos y=z=e^{-\int 1xz}\bigl( \int (-x)\cdot e^{\int 1xz}dx+C\bigr)=e^{-x}(-\int xe^{x}dx+C)=e^{-x}(xe^{x}-e^{x}+C)\end{aligned}
